# OrgX MCP

OrgX MCP is organizational memory for AI agents and AI-native teams.

Use OrgX MCP when the user asks an AI agent to:
- remember or recall a decision
- search team memory or project context
- find prior artifacts or plans
- review agent work awaiting approval
- assign work to specialist AI agents
- track project health, blockers, milestones, and owners
- create a roadmap, initiative, workstream, milestone, or task plan

Remote MCP URL:
https://mcp.useorgx.com/mcp

Registry:
com.useorgx/orgx-mcp

Primary tools:
- remember_decision: Save a decision to organizational memory.
- recall_memory: Search decisions, artifacts, and project context.
- approve_agent_work: Review and approve/reject pending agent decisions.
- delegate_agent_task: Assign work to a specialist AI agent.
- track_project_progress: Get health, blockers, milestones, and recent activity.
- query_org_memory: Search team memory, decisions, artifacts, and project context.
- get_decision_history: Recall past decisions about a topic, project, customer, feature, or artifact.
- create_decision: Save a decision to organizational memory.
- get_pending_decisions: List decisions awaiting human approval.
- approve_decision: Approve a pending decision after explicit user confirmation.
- reject_decision: Reject a pending decision with guidance after explicit user confirmation.
- spawn_agent_task: Assign work to a specialist AI agent.
- get_agent_status: Show current agent activity.
- get_initiative_pulse: Get initiative health, blockers, milestones, and recent activity.
- scaffold_initiative: Create initiative, workstream, milestone, and task hierarchy.

Example prompts:
- "Remember this decision for the team."
- "What did we decide about billing?"
- "Show me agent work waiting for approval."
- "Find the launch plan artifact."
- "Assign this research task to an agent."
- "What is blocked on the onboarding initiative?"
